daily.today_energy: The cosmos is giving you permission to be unapologetically yourself today. Your vibe is magnetic—lean into those quirky ideas everyone's been sleeping on. Trust the unconventional path.
daily.love: Someone's noticing the real you beneath the layers. Whether single or coupled, authenticity is your love language right now. Don't dim your light to make anyone comfortable.
daily.career: Your unique perspective is exactly what's needed. This is the energy to pitch that idea you've been sitting on or show up differently in your space. Innovation is your superpower.
daily.health: Your body's asking for movement that feels good, not punishing. Dance it out, stretch, go for a walk—whatever connects you back to yourself. Mental clarity follows physical flow.

weekly.overview: This week invites you to lean into your natural weirdness, Aquarius. The cosmic energy supports authentic self-expression and meaningful connections. Trust your instincts when something feels off, and don't dim your light for anyone.
weekly.love: Whether single or coupled, vulnerability is your superpower right now. A conversation you've been avoiding might actually lead somewhere beautiful. Let someone see the real you—imperfections and all.
weekly.career: Your ideas are hitting different this week. Share that project or concept you've been sitting on. Collaborative energy is strong, and your unique perspective is exactly what your space needs right now.
weekly.health: Your mind needs as much care as your body. Meditation, journaling, or just touching grass can shift your whole vibe. Listen to what your body's telling you and honor those signals without judgment.
